Insertion-Sort(A)
1  for j ← 2 to length[A]
2    do key ← A[j]

4       i ← j - 1
5       while i > 0 and A[i] > key
6         do A[i + 1] ← A[i]
7            i ← i - 1
8       A[i + 1] ← key
